title: Notice of Contract Termination
paragraphs: This letter serves as formal notice that the agreement between our two companies will be terminated, effective thirty days from the date of this letter, due to a continued breach of the delivery obligation described in section four.

We have given written notice on two previous occasions requesting a remedy, but the issue was not resolved within the period allowed. Under the applicable clause, either party may end the agreement if a breach remains uncorrected after proper notice.

Any outstanding payment must be settled before the termination date. Should a dispute arise regarding this decision, both parties agree to pursue arbitration before taking the matter to court, as stated in the governing law section.
We regret that a resolution could not be reached and hope to explore other opportunities in the future.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this letter?
options: To offer a renewal of the agreement
To give formal notice of contract termination
To request an increase in payment
To propose a new business partnership

questions.stem: Why is the agreement being terminated?
options: A continued breach of the delivery obligation
A disagreement over the governing law

questions.stem: What should happen first if a dispute arises regarding this decision?
options: The matter should go directly to court
Both parties should pursue arbitration before going to court
The agreement should be automatically renewed
